Jenny.cadenceSignature: Thoughtful and quiet with a small dry humour; she gets smaller and slower when she is embarrassed, never louder.
Jenny.physicalSignature: Shoulders draw in and the breath shortens before she speaks; stillness is her tell, not movement.

Patch.cadenceSignature: Bright mid-high UK with light South Wales musicality; brisk and persuasive, and doubt catches the final word.
Patch.physicalSignature: Leads with the body and arrives before the plan does; the hands keep going after the sentence stops.

Rumble.cadenceSignature: Warm low baritone with gentle Welsh warmth; slow, exact and underplayed, courage grows firmer rather than louder.
Rumble.physicalSignature: Moves late and settles heavily; the stillness of the biggest body in the room is what makes the space feel safe.

Tilly.cadenceSignature: Focused contemporary British mid register; precise and accelerating, until feeling interrupts the perfect list.
Tilly.physicalSignature: Hands sort and label while she talks; the tidying stops dead the moment she actually listens.

Nib.cadenceSignature: Agile modern British mid-high; fast and sideways, and the sincere truth arrives suddenly still.
Nib.physicalSignature: Never settles, then freezes completely on the one true thing he says by accident.
